translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Kata kawuono pod aywagora ka an gi chuny malit;
nikech kum mapek ma Nyasaye oketo kuoma miya achur ka an gi rem malich.
Ka dine bed ni angʼeyo kuma dayudie Nyasaye;
kendo kata dabed ni anyalo dhi nyaka kuma odakie;
to dine aterone ywakna,
kendo anyise gik mopongʼo chunya,
mondo afweny gima doduoka
kendo angʼe gima onyalo wacho.
Bende doti gi tekone maduongʼ mondo okweda?
Ooyo, ok dochun weche kuoma ni an jaketho.
Kuno ema ngʼama ja-adiera teroe ywakne,
kendo kuno ema jal mangʼadona bura diweyae thuolo.
“To kata ka adhi yo wuok chiengʼ to oonge kuno;
ka adhi yo podho chiengʼ bende ok ayude.
Ka odich otiyo yo nyandwat, to ok anene;
to ka olokore ochomo yo milambo to kuno bende ok anyal nene.
To ongʼeyo yora maluwo;
bangʼ tema to abiro wuok aa e tem ka achalo dhahabu.
Tiendena osebedo kaluwo okangene adimba;
asebedo ka aluwo yorene ma ok abar.
Pok aweyo mak aluwo chike mowuok e dhoge;
to asekawo weche mowuok e dhoge kaka mwandu maduongʼ moloyo chiemba mapile.
“En to ochungʼ kar kende, koso en ngʼa madipiem kode?
Otimo gima en owuon ema ohero.
Obiro chopo gima nosechano chon,
kendo pod en gi chenro machal kamago mokanona mathoth.
Mano emomiyo kibaji maduongʼ omaka e nyime,
kendo kaparo gigi duto to amiye luor.
Nyasaye osemiyo chunya ool;
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osemiyo kibaji omaka.
Kata bed ni mudho odino wangʼa kamano,
to mudhono ok nyal miya luoro.
